text:
[Council File 26-1618]
Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report and Resolution relative to the submission of a Continued and Funding Expansion Application to the California Department of Social Services for subsidized preschool services at the Department of Recreation and Parks' licensed preschools through the General Child Care and Development Program (CCTR) for Fiscal Year 2027-28. (This matter is also referred to the Budget and Finance Committee.)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
